subject: Fix memory allocation size in getClusterNodesList (#2932)
reason: The change shrinks an over-allocation in getClusterNodesList from (count+1)*CLUSTER_NAMELEN (40 bytes/element) to the correct (count+1)*sizeof(char *) (8 bytes/element). The old size was always larger than needed, so there was never an out-of-bounds access, crash, or data risk — only wasted heap.
